business_summary: Shiva Texyarn Limited engages in the manufacturing of yarn and technical textile products in India and internationally. The company offers combed, slub, fancy, and carded and compact yarns; lamination products for mattress protectors, medical textiles, industrial and military applications, and outdoor clothing fabric-breathable shells; and digital canvas products, including poly cotton, cotton canvas, and polyester canvas. It also provides reusable and washable sheet for protection against bed-wetting; mattress protectors; art canvas; digital printing medium products for digital banners, bags, backpacks, home finishes, and offset printing applications; and knitwear, outwear, and military and tactical gears. In addition, the company is involved in processing of performance fabrics, such as high fastness, moisture wicking properties, and delicate fabrics. It offers its products under the Quick Dry, Quick Fit, Q-Club, Paw Paw, STYLFIN, and INIDSHAPE brands. The company was formerly known as Annamalai Finance Ltd and changed its name to Shiva Texyarn Limited in January 2003. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Coimbatore, India. Shiva Texyarn Limited operates as a subsidiary of Vedanayagam Hospital Private Limited.
